title: Why Car Washes Push the Unlimited Plan #shorts
summary: Mister Car Wash's 2025 annual report says a member spends more than four times what a retail customer does; members were 76% of its 2025 wash sales.
sources: Mister Car Wash 2025 Form 10-K: 548 locations in 21 states at Dec 31, 2025; "In 2025, we increased overall UWC penetration from 74% to 76% of total wash sales"; "UWC Members contribute a significant portion of our net revenue and provide recurring revenue through their monthly membership fees"; a UWC member "spends more than four times the retail car wash consumer" (Item 1): https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1853513/000119312526078965/mcw-20251231.htm

scenes.narration: A car wash member spends more than four times what a regular customer does.
That's Mister Car Wash's own number, from its annual report.
And members already bring in {76 percent|seventy-six percent} of its wash sales in {2025.|twenty twenty-five.}
The unlimited plan isn't a discount. It's the business.
